long_biography.plain_text:
Freight markets have been the defining focus of Demetrios Polemis's investment work. As a hedge-fund co-founder, he has argued that better information, screen-based trading and exchange products have improved market transparency. His public commentary spans tanker-forward liquidity, options, counterparty access and obstacles that still deter smaller shipowners.

Polemis is a direct owner and control person of the Guernsey investment manager behind several related private funds. Its principal freight-markets vehicle has raised outside capital continuously since 2014 and is structured for accredited investors. This combination of institutional ownership and instrument-level expertise places his public role squarely between asset management and maritime risk markets.
